name: OpenELIS Global Core (1.x)
what_it_is: OpenELIS Global Core is a Java/Struts web application providing a laboratory information system (LIS) for resource-constrained clinical and reference laboratories, covering order entry, specimen tracking, result entry, QA, and reporting. This is the 1.x branch, explicitly declared end-of-life by the project; active development has moved to OpenELIS-Global-2.
components: Struts 1.x MVC servlet for all web actions
Hibernate ORM data access layer backed by PostgreSQL
AnalyzerImport servlet with reader plugins for Cobas C311, Cobas Taqman, Evolis, FACSCanto, FACSCalibur, Sysmex
DataExchange subsystem: HL7 order intake, result reporting, aggregate/malaria reporting
Report engine using JasperReports for patient, workplan, QA, and aggregate reports
LabelMaker servlet generating ZPL-II barcode labels for Zebra printers
protocols: HL7 v2.5.1 (OML_O21 messages for electronic lab orders)
HL7 v2.x for result reporting outbound
HTTP POST and HTTP GET for external result/aggregate report sending
ZPL-II for Zebra barcode label printing
measurement: Sample status progression (quick entry, entry complete, released, label printed)
Analysis status (assigned, canceled, result completed, released, verified)
Non-conformity counts by category, date, and lab number
configuration: Application name, datasource, page sizes, label printer name/copies/ZPL-II parameters
HL7 transport IDs and processing IDs
Analyzer plugin JARs dropped into plugin directory at runtime
modes: Quick entry (abbreviated sample and order entry flow)
Workplan mode (lab bench worklist by test or test section)
Electronic order intake mode (HL7 OML_O21 orders from external systems)
constraints: Declared end-of-life (1.x branch); no active upstream maintenance
Requires PostgreSQL with a specific schema; no other database backend is supported
Quartz scheduler uses in-memory store only; scheduled job state is lost on restart
HL7 order intake is limited to OML_O21 (v2.5.1) message type only
Label printing assumes ZPL-II compatible Zebra printers; no other label format supported
No Docker Compose or container-based deployment provided
notable_absences: No FHIR interface (FHIR support is in OpenELIS-Global-2 only)
No REST or SOAP API layer
No automated test suite with documented coverage
No audit log export or SIEM integration
No TLS/HTTPS configuration within the application itself
